outcome: Parental preferences for content and delivery method of behavioral health guidance in pediatric primary care
Parents' overall interest in behavioral guidance
cohort: The study included 396 parents of young children recruited from primary care offices.
finding: Most parents are interested in behavioral guidance as part of primary care, but their preferences for content and delivery methods vary by socioeconomic factors, child behavior problems, and parenting style.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at the time of recruitment from primary care offices.
